description: A route naming a provider with no adapter is refused WHEN SAVED, not when called. The alternative is a route that saves cleanly and fails an hour later on a different screen, after a prompt has been typed — at which point nobody connects the failure to the settings. Like every other not-found in this protocol, it lists what IS available.

data.what: route "gemini-route" names provider "gemini", which has no adapter; the registered providers are anthropic, openai
data.means: a route needs an id, a model name and a provider that has an adapter; it is checked now rather than at call time, so a bad route cannot fail later on a different screen
data.todo: the message says which part is wrong, and lists the registered providers where the provider is at fault
